critical_findings.title: 618 inline JSON-output branches across cmd/
critical_findings.fix: Introduce an output presenter interface (JSON/table implementations built once per run) and call it unconditionally from handlers

critical_findings.title: 45 god functions over 80 lines (worst 238)
critical_findings.fix: Split runObjectPut/handleKeyMsg/loadBuiltinThemes into per-path helpers; enforce golangci-lint funlen=80

critical_findings.title: Two coexisting command error-flow idioms (Run+printErrorAndExit with os.Exit vs RunE)

critical_findings.title: cmd package coverage 44.6% with no CI executing the suites
critical_findings.fix: Add output-mode table tests for the 10 highest-traffic commands; add a mandatory pre-release local test gate

critical_findings.title: Committed transcripts and GOrchestra logs contain secret-pattern text and 570K+ lines of non-code
critical_findings.fix: Redact/purge transcript and log history to an out-of-repo archive; gitignore GOrchestra/**/*.log

critical_findings.title: Shared getAPIClient factory defined inside domain file object.go
Raw cmd.Start() violates project's own process-spawning rule (ROAD-525)
critical_findings.fix: Use daemon.SpawnAsync() or a tracked spawn wrapper

critical_findings.title: Legacy r2go2: error prefix leaks into cosmoflare UX
critical_findings.fix: Change prefix to cosmoflare:; keep ~/.r2go2 config path for compat
